images.alt: Dev Patel as Sir Gawain in The Green Knight fro A24 Films. A man with dark hair and a mustache holding an axe with a velvet stained cloak and trees in the background; all is washed in golden yellow.
Dev Patel as Sir Gawain in The Green Knight by A24 Films in a yellow cloak of velvet, standing by a horse. He is by a stone building, the horse is brown. He is greasy-haired and scowling.
Dev Patel as Sir Gawain in the Green Knight from A24 films. On horseback at the beginning of his adventure, a white lime road behind him, staring out. He wears chain mail and the same yellow cloak.
Dev Patel as Sir Gawain; in a grey doublet, holding a sword, looking up, against a black background.
A figure walking across a bog, yellow cloak across shoulders. From The Green Knight.
Knights gathered around King Arthur dressed in robes of gold and saffron, ochre and brown. Very similar aesthetic.
I'm not sure how to describe this because there are kings and people with swords, and the Green Knight with his head cut off, and Gawain, presumably, with the axe like WTF, wearing red.

A woman in profile in a blue and yellow crêpe silk head veil. Her eyes are covered in linen. Her hair is long, and she wears an amulet of some kind. This is the Mother of Gawain played by Sarita Choudhury.
Dev Patel as Sir Gawain, looking down with a high-necked chained cape and chain, multiple textures in grey.

Sean Harris as the King in The Green Knight. He wears a crown that has a regular crown and then a HALO CROWN PIECE. He has a cloak with bits of embossed metal on it (like medals) and a chemise under, with a pentacle pendant.
A man on top of the wheel being happy, man on bottom being crushed. Golden wheel in the middle.
Reconstructed shield from the British Museum with shield bosses. Some look like long ovals, others are circles, some look like dragon shapes.
Queen Guinevere has lots of flair. Her black dress is covered in pins of all shapes and sizes.
Sean Harris as King (Arthur) and his shiny pendant. All the shiny.

Alicia Vikander in Sir Gawain and the Green Knight, wearing teal velvet and sheers. Her hair is up in an intricate braided bouffant. Light is on one half of her face, her brown eyes are almost caramel.
The Green Knight is like an ornery old Ent in Armor, a bluish green hue.
Angry looking Dev Patel, cast in green.
From the Nero Cotton MSS, a knight in a green blanket, sleeping.
Gawain in a green doorway, lit in yellow, axe in hand (still wearing his yellow cloak)
